log_extraction: Decode original JSON with arbitrary precision integers; remove logger timestamps including BOM-prefixed segment timestamps and only the exact interleaved optional-NumPy source line. Original strict report SHA and complete mismatch-list SHA match the original emitted receipts.

cpython_report.scope: RNE binary64 add/subtract/multiply/divide/sqrt and binary32 conversion; signed zeros, infinities, gradual underflow, NaN classification and packet admission. This does not qualify all binary64 bit patterns, dtype promotion, tensor kernels, floating-point flags or alternate rounding modes.
